tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen through the imagegen skill; no CLI fallback.
purpose: Decorative desktop Home body-type, brand, inventory and buying-advice section banner backgrounds.
constraints: No text, identity, vehicles, UI or red lines. Keep the center quiet for existing live headings and actions.
delivery: Full-frame WebP encoding using Sharp/libvips at quality 84 and effort 6. No crop, compositing or pixel retouching. Desktop CSS uses center/cover; media queries prevent use below 992px.
generatedSourceBackup: Per-asset original PNG copies are preserved under the ignored runtime Home-banner work directories. Original generated images remain at the tool's default location.

assets.name: body
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a finished raster background plate for an existing premium automotive website's shallow desktop section banner, Browse by body type. Landscape panoramic composition approximately 3:1, 3072 by 1024 if possible. The site centers white heading text and a white pill button on top inside a banner approximately 1360 by 164. BACKGROUND ONLY, not UI.
Primary request: a restrained black graphite background with sweeping satin-metal contours at the far left and far right, suggesting sculpted automotive bodywork without depicting a car or an identifiable part. Layer two or three broad, gently curved graphite surfaces with softly lit silver-grey edges, plus very fine sparse halftone dots fading toward the center. Clean, believable material, precision and quiet visual depth. This belongs to the same dark perforated graphite family as a companion brand-discovery banner, but use flowing contoured planes instead of prominent grille perforations.
Composition: detail only in outer 22 percent at each side. The central 56 percent is nearly flat charcoal approximately #15181d, entirely empty and uniform for text and button. Texture and satin highlights stay visible within the middle vertical quarter when cropped into an 8:1 strip. Balanced visual weight at both edges, extremely low-contrast highlights and no highlight running across the center.
Palette: neutral graphite black, charcoal and restrained silver-grey. No blue, no gold, no red line, no luminous colors.
Constraints: no cars, wheels, car silhouettes, manufacturer logos, letters, numbers, people, road, buildings, icons, UI, buttons, border, frame, watermark, sci-fi panels, chrome tubes, concentric rings, streaks, smoke, light flares or neon. No bright or busy detail behind centered copy. One full-bleed background plate.

assets.name: inventory

assets.name: guides-editorial
assets.purpose: Active Home advice banner; editorial flat lay replaces the repeated vehicle pair.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a finished raster background for a premium automotive website's Home buying-advice/blog section. One panoramic landscape plate, approximately 3:1. The existing website crops the central horizontal band to a very shallow 8:1 banner about 1360 by 164, and overlays centered live white heading text plus a white button. BACKGROUND ART ONLY.
Primary request: a restrained editorial flat lay on a matte graphite-black desk. At the far left, part of an open high-quality black linen notebook with off-white pages and one slim dark metal pen. At the far right, the edge of a neatly arranged off-white inspection checklist/document folder, with a few small empty square boxes and fine grey horizontal rules. These should suggest useful reading, research and a practical buyer's guide. Use physically believable paper edges, linen and satin metal with understated soft studio shadows. No car imagery.
Composition: balanced but asymmetric editorial arrangements at the outermost 20 percent on each side. The central 60 percent is completely empty, smooth near-black graphite around #15181d, for centered title and button. Subjects must remain recognizable within the middle vertical third, because only this shallow horizontal band is visible after cropping; intentional partial objects entering from the far left/right edges, not large tall objects lost above/below the crop. Keep all notebook and paper edges outside the central title area. Straight overhead photography with calm precision, clean material detail, no scene perspective.
Palette: neutral charcoal black, soft off-white paper and muted grey. Related to a family of black satin and brushed graphite automotive banners, but this one has an editorial reading/research identity. Small highlights only at outer edges; no red lines, blue tint, gold or neon.
Text: none. The checklist contains only restrained empty square boxes and straight blank rules, no words, letters, numbers, illegible filler, brands or logos. Notebook pages mostly blank with faint ruled lines.
Constraints: no cars, car cutouts, wheels, vehicle silhouettes, people, hands, phones, screens, web mockups, interface elements, UI buttons, title text, watermark, border, framing, smoke, glossy sci-fi material or excessive objects. One polished full-bleed photographic banner plate, with uninterrupted dark central negative space.
